forms.silhouette: A massive, monolithic cube with thick armored plating and blunt, mountain-like ridges along every edge.
forms.surface: Thick, cracked stone armor casting a faint shadow over its own plating.
forms.vfx: A deep ground-thud with a rolling rumble and a burst of cracked-stone shards on absorb.

forms.name: Colossal Grey Runt
forms.flavor: Steps on mountains and calls it a light jog.
forms.silhouette: A massive, monolithic cube with thick armored plating and blunt, mountain-like ridges along every edge.
forms.surface: Colossal, boulder-like plating with visible fault-lines glowing faintly at the seams.
forms.vfx: A mountain-shaking stomp-pulse with a booming echo and a spray of rock fragments on absorb.

forms.name: Godslaying Grey Runt
forms.flavor: Ended the food chain, then ate the chain.
forms.silhouette: A massive, monolithic cube with thick armored plating and blunt, mountain-like ridges along every edge.
forms.surface: Fully fused obsidian-stone armor, monolithic and seamless, radiating a faint heat-haze.
forms.vfx: A world-shaking impact flash, a cracking ground shockwave ring, and a rain of molten debris on absorb.
